versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "行业情报" (Industry Intelligence) skill.
- Enables structured competitor resource library creation and maintenance for any industry.
- Continuously collects and assesses information in seven categories: regulatory/policy updates, media, official corporate releases, business activity, enterprise digitalization, international peers, and rumors.
- Standardizes file output locations—separates read-only skill assets from all writable workspace outputs.
- Strictly enforces safe script execution, with clear compliance for environments using exec preflight.
- Automatically triggers for user queries mentioning key industry intelligence topics or competitor activities.
